items.q: The transcript contains no direct interaction or personal relationship description between the interviewee (Ferrand Clementin) and St. Joe. ctx.x: Well, you could just hop on the two-lane bell, aren't you? Yeah, on the two-lane bell.

Yeah, on the two-lane bell. Yeah, right there. Oh, yeah. You go to the back in the house. And you go to the river and come back and see. Come back and go around. You know, you pick St. Joe and come to see. Yeah, they pick St. Joe. And one used to be going that big, you see. You see. Yeah. On the roof guard.
But that must have been a nice rod, huh? Oh, lovely rod.
